Totaling up mortgage values on my other properties gets me roughly $860 more in liquidity, plus the $473 cash gives me about $1333 to work with. Building 3 houses on each light blue costs $450, pushing rents to $270 on Oriental/Vermont and $300 on Connecticut—that's a strong enough return to justify going all-in now and mortgaging other properties later if I need more cash.
